parsed.rationale: A new analyst receives an 'access denied' message after accepting an invite, while other users can log in normally. This is an account/workspace access issue that requires human investigation to restore access.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — thanks for the details. I’m sorry the new analyst is getting an “access denied” message after accepting the invite.

Because this appears to be user-specific workspace access (other users can log in normally), we’ll need a quick human review to check the invite/account provisioning and her workspace role/permissions.

To help us resolve this as quickly as possible today, please reply with:
1) Workspace name and/or Workspace ID
2) The exact text of the “access denied” message and where it appears (login page vs. in-app)
3) The email address the invite was sent to (or the analyst’s exact identity)
4) Whether your workspace uses SSO or email/password for sign-in
5) Any timestamp for when she accepted the invite and encountered the error
6) If available, any screenshot and/or request ID/error ID shown in the UI

Once we have that, we’ll escalate to the team that can review the account/invite state and restore access for your analyst.
promised_actions: Escalate this ticket for human review focused on invite/account provisioning and workspace permissions for the invited analyst
Follow up after reviewing the provided workspace and error details to determine the quickest path to restore access
safety_notes: Avoid claiming root cause or resolution until logs/audit trail are reviewed.
Do not promise a refund or specific SLA; state escalation and request minimum necessary details.

parsed.customer_impact: The new analyst is blocked from accessing the workspace, preventing them from working; this could delay analyst onboarding and ongoing operations for the team.
grounded_facts: A new analyst was invited yesterday.
After accepting the invite, she receives an “access denied” message.
Other users can log in normally.
The request is to get the analyst into the workspace today.
missing_information: Workspace name/ID and any relevant project/team context
Exact wording of the “access denied” message and where it appears (web/app/log-in screen)
Whether the invite was sent to the correct email/identity and whether she has any existing accounts
What authentication method is used for the workspace (e.g., SSO vs. email/password), if applicable
Whether the analyst has any specific role/permissions assigned or group membership tied to the invite
Time of the issue and whether it started only for this analyst or others
Any error details from logs/audit trail (invite status, failed permission checks, account provisioning status)
risk_signals: High urgency due to blocked access for a newly onboarded user
Potential account/permission misconfiguration or failed provisioning indicated by the invite accept step leading to “access denied”
Ambiguity in scope since other users can log in normally, suggesting a user-specific access/role issue rather than a general outage
parsed.summary: A newly invited analyst receives an “access denied” message after accepting the invite, and needs access to the workspace urgently.
